queries.note: Easy: one famous performer, exact name. Sites with performer pages should nail it.
Easy-medium: one common category word; titles often don't say it.
Medium: two concepts, both must hold; one alone is only loosely related.
Hard: a scenario described in many wordings; titles rarely use the exact words.
Hardest: vague amateur intent, many words, weak site search; looks and mood matter more than keywords.
